description: This file defines the interface for the DobbySpecGenerator class, which appears to generate JSON specifications for runtime container configurations based on application and runtime settings. It includes method declarations for creating various plugin configurations, mounts, and environment settings, indicating its role in container or runtime environment setup.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JSON specifications for container runtime configurations, including environment variables, mounts, and plugin configurations based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the runtime specification based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates JSON environment variables for the runtime configuration.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates JSON mount configurations for the runtime environment.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for RDK plugins.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for minidump plugin.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for network plugin.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a JSON representation of a bind mount with source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines whether GPU should be enabled based on application configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves system memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves GPU memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU (Video Processing Unit) is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing CPU cores to be allocated.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates JSON with classic plugin configurations.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for Ethan logging plugin.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for multicast socket plugin.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for ion memory plugin.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for Thunder plugin.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for OpenCDM plugin.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates JSON configuration for private data mount.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates mount points related to FKPS.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount point JSON configuration.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates resource manager mount point configuration.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Retrieves the working directory configuration for runtime.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes JSON data related to Ion heaps.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string.
